question: Which of the following represents a visible biological hazard in food?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Caterpillars__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Caterpillars in food represent a visible biological hazard, which can be seen with the naked eye, unlike microorganisms.
 
• Biological hazards in food include bacteria, viruses, parasites, fungi, and visible pests such as caterpillars that contaminate food.
 
• Visible hazards like caterpillars are easier to detect and remove compared to microscopic hazards, which require laboratory analysis.
 
• Preventing contamination from visible pests involves proper storage, handling, and processing of food to maintain its safety and quality.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
